item.description:
# Ghostex 11.2.2
## 11.2.2 - 2026-11-10
**Ghostex 11.2.2 is out.** Phones and Easy Connect computers stay connected through restarts and slow links, iPhone voice calls work even when the call microphone keeps stopping, Dictate never loses a recording, messages between agents fold into "Worked for", approvals work across your connected computers, and Android gets push notifications.
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhones on 11.2.1 already have this release's phone fixes:** they arrived over the air, and the last ones come with this release's update. Per-computer Easy Connect keys and the full fix for the iPhone call microphone come with a later iPhone app; Android gets everything in this release's app. - **The phone is back right away after Ghostex restarts or updates on your computer:** over Easy Connect, the phone reconnects within a few seconds of Ghostex coming back, instead of showing "Reconnecting to …" for half a minute or more. - **The phone stays connected on a slow connection:** on weak cellular, or when Easy Connect or Tailscale goes the long way round, the phone no longer starts over while a chat, a long reply or a picture you're sending is still coming through, so nothing is lost, and a connection that really drops is still noticed and restored within seconds. - **A phone with two or more Easy Connect computers keeps them all connected:** once your phone app is updated, it connects to each computer with its own key, so connecting to one no longer stalls another for half a minute. Ghostex on your computers is ready for it now, and phones on the current app keep working as before. - **A phone on Tailscale or SSH asks each computer to pair once:** reopening the app or reconnecting waits on the same request instead of asking again, and one plain card says where to approve ("Approve this phone?" in Ghostex on that computer) and what waits meanwhile; it stays away for a computer that's asleep or that you hid. - **Android: push notifications reach the phone:** with this release's Android app, finished, waiting and error notifications arrive as push notifications. iPhones get them with a later iPhone app.
### 🎙️ Voice and Dictate
- **iPhone voice calls work even when the call microphone keeps stopping:** on iPhones where the call's microphone stops right after it starts (iOS 27 with the 11.2.1 app), the call switches to recorded turns: hold Talk, speak and let go to send, and the agent's replies show on screen and are read aloud. Needs Ghostex updated on the computer. - **A voice call survives Ghostex restarting on your computer:** a phone that reconnects to a call the restart cut off gets a new call with the same settings straight away (the screen says it is a new call), instead of "That conversation already ended", and Ghostex's log says how each call ended and when a microphone stopped sending sound. - **The phone's voice agent says what's missing and where:** when a computer has no voice key (or can't read it, or has the voice agent off), the phone names that computer and says to add the key in Settings > Voice Agent there; a call about all your sessions uses another computer that has a key, and "The microphone stopped." shows once instead of over and over. - **Dictate on the phone never loses a recording:** the phone keeps your audio until its words are in the chat box. If your computer can't be reached, it says "Waiting for your computer…" and sends it again on its own once the connection is back; leaving the chat keeps the recording, which waits above the chat box as "Recording not transcribed" with Transcribe, Share (iPhone) and ✕.
### 💬 Chat
- **Messages between agents and your answers fold into "Worked for":** with Tool call cards on (or Agent work set to Reduced), "Message to …", "Message from …" and "You answered …" cards no longer stand on their own; the turn's "Worked for" line counts them ("2 messages", "1 answer") and opening it shows them first, on the computer and the phone. - **The pills above the chat box no longer scroll or fade away:** when the row does not fit, pills drop their label from the right (icon and count stay, hover shows the name), and only then do the last ones go into one "+N" pill that lists them. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Bigger text in the chat box's popovers and pills:** the Context window popover, the pills above the chat box and the lists they open use the same size as the model name (they were 9.5 to 12.5 px), with taller rows and wider menus so nothing clips. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Questions with previews show each option's preview in full:** in the "Needs your answer" card a preview shows up to 10 lines, then scrolls with a visible scrollbar, and long lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping, so mockups stay lined up (#524). - **Press Enter while a pasted picture is still saving and the message goes at once,** with a loading tile where the picture will be; after a moment the Back to composer arrow lets you take it back, and a picture that can't be saved brings the message back with its error. - **Dialogs over the chat no longer black it out:** Save to Markdown and Rewind keep the conversation in view behind a light dim, and so does the Agents Hub's sync sheet; in Ghostex Web, every dialog laid over the page. - **Your messages to a coordinator show only what you typed,** with no "your playbook changed" line under them, and View playbook is on a coordinator's right-click menu, its chat's More actions menu, the phone's long-press menu and Settings > Chat > Coordinator playbook. - **New installs show no status line under the chat box** until you star items in Context details; everyone who already used Ghostex keeps the line they had, and Reset to recommended still pins the suggested setup. - **Claude Code's Fable 5.2 is in the model menu:** pick it and the pill shows Fable 5.2 instead of falling back to Fable 5.1, which still works too.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Remote machines over Easy Connect stay connected** (#526): a computer you control through Easy Connect no longer keeps dropping and reattaching its terminals, because all of its connections now share one link instead of competing with each other. - **Approve your connected computers' requests from the computer that controls them:** a request shows Approve only where approving it works. A computer with its own Ghostex app asks you once, there, to let this computer answer its requests; after that its cards work from here. Until then a notice says where to approve. - **Agents see the computers you connected, and say what's missing:** `ghostex computers` and every `--computer` command list a computer that still waits for your "Let the agents on … reach each other" approval and say which computer shows that card, instead of saying none is connected. - **Settings > Remote shows the Ghostex version a computer is really running,** the same as its About screen; when its background service still runs an older build, the tile says so ("background service 10.45.0") and what to do, and a failed version read is tried again within a minute. - **A remote computer's session drags onto the work area** to split a pane or show it in the middle, like a local one, pinned or not, in the Separate-by-machine tabs or the Unified sidebar. - **No more "Git unavailable on Windows" notice at every start:** Git stays quiet for a computer that isn't connected yet (or is asleep) and fills in once it connects; clicking Commit or the Git menu says plainly that it isn't connected, or is connecting.
### 🔒 Pairing and security
- **A phone pairing over Tailscale or SSH no longer opens Easy Connect to any device while it waits.** - **The "still use the old pairing" count in Settings > Remote counts only devices that really need pairing again:** it skips phones you removed, older or unused pairings, phones that now sign in over Tailscale or SSH and phones waiting for your Approve, and each old pairing that needs nothing has Forget. - **Settings > Remote's Relay picker fits its labels, and each option has an (i)** that explains Ghostex relay, Public relays only and Custom on hover. - **Settings > Remote's tab strips and pickers keep their labels off the edges at narrow widths,** shortening them with an ellipsis instead.
### 🧩 Settings, Files and accounts
- **Settings > Accounts: adding a Claude or Codex account you removed earlier no longer gets stuck** ("already saved, use its Reconnect action" or "Login did not complete"): Ghostex repairs the leftover saved entry and saves your sign-in without asking you to sign in again, and a sign-in that still fails says why, with Copy details. - **Settings > Extensions: click an installed or Community extension's tile to open its page** (details, settings, permissions, version, Update or Uninstall); Back returns to the same tab. - **Files moves lines with Option+Up and Option+Down** (Alt+Up / Alt+Down on Windows and Linux): the current line, or every line the selection touches, moves by one line, like VS Code, one undo step each.
### 🤖 GBots (beta)
- **Calls with a GBot:** call a GBot from its row or one of its chats through the Voice agent; it answers in its own voice (chosen in GBot Settings), says what it is doing while it works, asks permission prompts out loud (Touch ID approvals stay on the computer or phone), and the call's turns land in its chat.

# Ghostex 11.2.1
## 11.2.1 - 2026-11-09
**Ghostex 11.2.1 is out.** GBots come back as Ghostex's own bots (beta, off by default), chats get opt-in looks and one / key for skills, cloning runs in the background, Settings and Extensions get tidier, iPhone voice calls keep the microphone, and Windows and macOS get a round of fixes.
### 🤖 GBots (beta)
- **GBots are now Ghostex's own bots (beta, off by default):** turn on Main Hub, then GBots in Settings > Extensions > Experimental. The previous GBots and its separate download are gone; their bots and chats were not carried over, and their old files are in your Trash as "GBots (previous)". The Bots space shows Hermes bots again. - **GBots sit in Main Hub under Chief of Staff** on your computer and phone, each with its icon and colour and its chats folding under it; New Chat, GBot Settings and Remove GBot are a right-click (or long press) away, and GBot folders never show as projects. - **Chief of Staff hands work to your GBots:** it gives a job to the right GBot or asks one a question and gets the answer back in its chat; when no GBot fits it adds one and tells you in a "GBot added" card you can undo (Settings > Agents makes it ask first). `ghostex gbots ask`, `assignments`, `changes` and `undo` are new. - **GBots remember:** each GBot keeps short dated notes that load into every chat, longer topic notes and a daily log, and the oldest notes move to an archive when memory fills up. The Memory tab shows what loads and lets you edit or undo any change, and `ghostex gbots prefs set` sets preferences every GBot follows. - **GBot routines:** ask a GBot for something on a schedule and it sets a routine; a free check (new mail, a calendar event, a web page, a folder or a command) runs first so a quiet day costs nothing, each run is a chat of that GBot, and a "Routine set" card has Pause, Edit and Undo. - **GBot departments** group GBots with shared instructions and a lead who hands the others work; they show as small headings under GBots. - **GBots tell Chief of Staff when they're stuck:** a GBot chat that can't start, stops, goes quiet for 20 minutes or whose routine fails is reported to Chief of Staff, which restarts it where it stopped or tells you in two lines what only you can fix; it answers approvals only for GBots it added. - **Keep an eye on my day:** with Gmail or Google Calendar connected, Chief of Staff can set up Day Watcher, which briefs you every morning and warns you about a meeting about to start or important new mail, with a notification on your computer and phone. It only reads; Ghostex refuses anything it tries to send or change. - **Team files and presets:** export your GBots (or a department, or one GBot as a preset) as a JSON file with secrets removed, and import one with a preview first; routines arrive paused and Undo removes the whole import. New GBot can start from built-in or kept presets. - **GBot API:** an app or script on your computer can message a GBot and get its reply, or start one of its routines, with a key from GBot Settings > Bot API. It's off until you turn it on with your approval; messages from apps run in their own folder, can't read your secret folders, don't see the GBot's memory unless you allow it, and only you answer what they wait on. - **A computer per GBot:** in GBot Settings > Computer, a GBot's chats can run on one of your connected computers or a Cloud Box, still reading its instructions and keeping its memory here, optionally using that computer's screen and apps (Touch ID to give it more). - **GBots and Chief of Staff on Codex can run `ghostex` commands:** a new Codex GBot starts at Full access and Chief of Staff on Codex runs without asking; on macOS and Linux Codex still keeps them out of your secret folders. - **A GBot asked to start work in a folder adds it as a project** and starts the coordinator, thread or session there (`--path <folder>`), and nothing but a GBot's own chats can land in its hidden folder (#519). - **GBots hide completely while they are off,** including their chat cards, Quick Access folders and Automate routines, and GBot chats install the GBot playbook skill they are told to read, here and on a connected computer.
### 💬 Chat
- **Chat look settings (Settings > Chat > Advanced, all off by default):** messages that start at the left, your messages on a full-width band, the agent's work as one small line per message (Reduced) or behind a button on each reply (Quiet), the status line as the chat's last line, a chat box as wide as the transcript, and compact spacing; the phone follows the computer, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Tool call lines (Settings > Extensions > Experimental, off by default):** each run of an agent's tool calls is one quiet line you open to see its calls, and running calls now shimmer in every look. On the phone the switch is in Settings > Chat. - **/ is the one key for skills and commands with every agent:** the list shows the agent's skills, then its custom and plugin commands, then its built-in commands, each under a heading, and each agent receives a picked skill in its own spelling. $ still opens the same skills, and a Codex message with two skills no longer shows the text between them as a formula. - **The skill picker lists a Claude Code plugin's skills and commands as Claude Code loads them** (#513): skills named in its plugin.json, commands in nested folders or named by the manifest, and a picked command reaches Claude as /plugin:name. The prompt editor draws command pills like the chat does. - **A Claude chat on a Claude Swap account reopens again** (#521): Ghostex finds the conversation in that account's own history, and a chat whose conversation really is gone says so and offers Start fresh, which starts a new conversation in the same session instead of leaving the input box stuck. - **Right-click an HTML file an agent linked to Open in Browser** in a new Browser tab of the session's project (#515). - **File and folder paths in Ghostex's own screens open in Files when clicked** (Settings pages and their descriptions, dialogs, chat folders): `~` expands to your home folder, a right-click offers Copy path and Reveal in Finder, and a folder outside the project opens in your file manager. - **A session's 5h and 7d limits read as reset once the reset time has passed** and take the newest reading from its login, so an idle coordinator no longer keeps its old percentages (#514). - **Text strength raises an agent's reply from its standard colour,** so the slider works with Show thinking in grey on. - **The working line above the chat box no longer repeats the running tool call's words** when the transcript already shows them; it shows the agent's status or its working word and time instead. - **The pills strip fades each pill out at a scrolled edge** instead of painting a dark band over them, so no half-pill stub is left, on the computer and the phone. - **A click on the coordinator board that jumps into a chat closes the board first,** so the chat is visible. - **Session Links: an × on the Suggested header removes every suggestion** in two clicks (the first arms it red); they go to Removed and can be restored, on the computer, the web and the phone.
### 🧩 Settings and Extensions
- **The Extensions page is in tabs:** Built-in, Views, Panels & menus, Installed, Community and Experimental, with one search over every tab, a short title on each tile with its description behind an (i), and the page reopens on the tab you had open. - **Each experimental feature has its own switch in Extensions > Experimental,** replacing Enable Experimental Features; Faster rendering moved there from About. - **Grok, a new built-in extension (off by default):** a Grok button beside Claude's opens grok.com inside Ghostex, with several Grok logins kept apart (each signed in on its own) and a start page you can set in Settings > Files & Links. - **Settings > Updates has the machine picker and Update all machines:** pick a machine at the top to see and update only its agents and tools, or update every connected machine at once with a line per machine saying how it went. Not installed pills install on a click and spin while they do. - **Settings never shows a long build id, hash or path whole:** it shows it short, and pointing at it shows it in full. - **Settings > Security shows only while Extensions > Experimental > Security logs is on (off by default):** the log is still written, its alerts and `ghostex security log` work as before, and a security alert's link still opens the page. - **Problems in Settings read plainly:** each one leads with a sentence, raw installer and command output moves under Details with Copy details, pages that can't reach Ghostex's service show one empty state with Try again, and Accounts says "Sign in needed" quietly. - **The Home folder card is the last on Settings > Agents,** and its folders row starts folded to a count ("25 folders") that opens the editable list. - **Merge copies of the same repository, a switch in Settings > Sidebar & Sessions:** turn it off to keep two copies of one repository on a computer as two projects; the phone follows it (#518). - **Settings > Autopilot says when the supervisor wakes,** and a supervisor that can't start or wake is logged and retried less and less often instead of every 10 seconds. - **When Connectors, Workspaces, Main Hub or Bot automations are off, the terminal hint now names a command that works.** - **Long text in the Updates popover is cut with an ellipsis inside the popup,** and hovering shows it in full.
### 🌐 Remote computers and projects
- **Cloning a project no longer holds the Add Project dialog open:** it runs in the background behind a progress button in the header, a project on another computer can be cloned onto any connected computer from its right-click menu (Clone on…), and the folder browser lists your home folder's folders again. - **The machine dialog (Settings > Remote) shows less at first:** each field's explanation is an (i) that appears next to its label when you point at the field, errors still show under the field, and Agent access moved into Advanced as its first row. - **A failing machine's tile shows two words and a red dot,** and its sheet leads with the problem, Reconnect, Reinstall and Copy details. - **Threads started with `--computer` get `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_ROLE=thread` and `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_SESSION` too** (#523), so launch wrappers on that computer can tell them from your own sessions. - **An approval a connected computer waits on shows there even when its app missed the moment it was asked,** and the asking app no longer shows one only that computer's owner can answer. - **A phone on Tailscale or SSH no longer brings up the pair-again notice** or its "can't connect" line in Settings > Remote. - **A command to a connected computer no longer gets lost right after that computer's Ghostex restarted** (#520), and Ghostex's log says when and why an Easy Connect connection ended.
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhone voice calls keep the microphone** (#500): a call no longer loses it in a loop, "The microphone stopped." shows once, and Unmute or Talk brings it back. This arrives with the new iPhone app. - **A dropped connection says so on the phone** ("The connection to the computer dropped. Ghostex reconnects by itself…") instead of blaming Ghostex on the computer. - **The phone gets the chat look settings, Tool call lines, the / list's headings, GBots in Main Hub and the Suggested links ×** with this release.
### 🍎 macOS
- **`ghostex agents reload` works again on macOS** (#522): a reload, or any wake right after a sleep, no longer fails with "the session could not be started again" or "macOS refused to start it from this login", and a reload that still fails says why, as does a thread's report. - **A Mac's Ghostex service started from its app bundle finds its terminal program,** so a computer connecting to it no longer says its zmx program is missing, and start at login starts it the right way.
### 🪟 Windows
- **On Windows without Windows Hello, approvals take your Windows password** (#520) instead of needing a PIN: pairing a computer and letting it act as you. - **Glass set to "Wallpaper only" no longer crashes Ghostex at start** (#516), an open window picks up a new desktop wallpaper, and a solid-colour desktop no longer shows the previous picture blurred. - **A Windows computer no longer keeps trying to connect to itself every minute.** - **An administrator prompt nobody answers no longer holds pairing or SSH setup forever;** after 5 minutes Ghostex says so.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Daily, weekly and cron automations run at their time in your timezone** (they ran on UTC time before) and handle daylight-saving changes. - **Long chats are faster:** loading older rows ends in half the time, a new row no longer rebuilds the whole transcript, and questions, the coordinator board and Resources are no longer rebuilt on every event. - **Ghostex uses less of your computer while idle:** the menu bar, the settings poll, the sidebar's flash and spinners, account usage and coordinator panels do less work.

# Ghostex 11.2.0
## 11.2.0 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.2.0 is out.** Bots get your connected apps and sign-ins, pasted images send with your message, agents work across your projects without asking again, approvals open as centred dialogs, remote computers connect more smoothly, and Settings gets tidier.
### 🤖 Bots
- **GBots bots get every app you connect in Settings > Connectors** and your gh and Google sign-ins, with the same Ask, Allow and Never rules, and they answer setup questions with Ghostex's own screens. - **Bot chats stay calm:** no Autopilot nudges, and a Ghostex message never becomes a bot chat's title. - **One sidebar session per bot chat**, and a renamed bot chat keeps its name without "/rename" being typed to the bot.
### 💬 Chat
- **Enter waits for a pasted image and sends your text and the image together**, on the desktop, the web and the phone, and pasting is faster. - **Tool cards stay one line** with the running call in the header ("+2 more"), and open when a call waits for your approval. - **Red error lines are one-line cards**, and several pictures in one message show without "[Image #2]". - **A queued Codex message never leaves a stuck "left the queue" card** (#509). - **The Summary and Detailed view chips show their icon**, turning into the × to close, and handover headings below a one-click answer are styled again.
### 🔐 Approvals and agents
- **Agents work across your projects again without asking:** they message, start, type into, interrupt and answer sessions in any project, while pairing, Collab, security settings and starting an agent with approvals off still ask you. - **Every notice with a button is a centred dialog**, one at a time ("1 of 3"), and an "Approvals waiting" pill brings back the ones you put aside. Copy details sits with the buttons, and light dialogs' main buttons are frosted grey. - **A Claude Code prompt with the auto-block countdown is answered on the first click**, and an answered card dims with "Sending…".
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **A computer added with its password connects right away** (#508), and an Easy Connect computer that must pair again says so instead of retrying. - **A connected computer asks once to act as you**, not on every connect; a computer that is really this one never asks to let itself in, and an approved request takes effect at once. - **Settings > Remote has a Current machine card** with this computer's name, short name and SSH access, and it no longer checks SSH every 10 seconds. - **Windows can message a Mac when signed in as an administrator.**
### ⚙️ Settings and the window
- **Theme presets sit in one compact sideways row**, colour rows stack in a narrow window, and the Settings rail's groups read in sentence case with more room. - **Settings > Dictation explains Hex clearly**, with Install Hex (the official installer, after you confirm with Touch ID) and a link to anoma.ly/hex. - **View playbook shows the playbook your coordinators follow**, from the New Coordinator dialog, Settings and the right-click editor. - **macOS: full screen with transparency shows your blurred desktop picture** instead of black. - **macOS: Login Items lists Ghostex's helpers as Ghostex**, and Ghostex stops rewriting them on every start (#510). - **Main Hub (beta) in Settings > Extensions**, off by default.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **A session whose terminal ended outside Ghostex shows as sleeping and reopens** (#512), thanks to @bet4it. - **Chief is now Chief of Staff.** - **macOS: programs in your sessions reach the local network again** (#504). - **Coordinators: a message and a thread report sent at the same moment both arrive** (#505, #506), and a finished report no longer raises a false "not moving". - **Pins are one filled and outline pair everywhere**, and right-clicking a pinned extension's header icon offers Unpin and Disable. - **The extensions menu's Terminal chip reads in the light theme**, the × on toasts and board cards is easier to see, and Linear tickets linked by their ID open in the right workspace.

# Ghostex 11.1.1
## 11.1.1 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.1.1 is out.** Connected computers ask for your approval once instead of over and over, the pair-again notice walks you through each device, the settings that open your computer up are yours alone, agent skills arrive signed, Linux follows COSMIC's display scale, and many fixes.
### 🔐 Security and pairing
- **A connected computer asks once:** one approval card per pair of computers, never a PIN prompt every minute, and with Agent access off it never asks at all. - **The pair-again notice lists each device on its own row** with one status and a page per device, and tells you the good news: the security review is done and pairing again takes a moment. It asks for a pairing code only after you press Show code. - **Phones that sign in over SSH or Tailscale pair with matching words**, a re-paired computer counts as paired, and a phone you deny is told so. Every Easy Connect copy gives a code that can pair. - **Some things are yours alone, in Settings:** installing or turning on an extension and its permissions, secret providers, joining or setting up a team, and the settings that loosen security. Agents can't ask for these; they point you to the page. - **Install from folder… in Settings > Extensions** installs an extension from a folder, with the permissions you tick. - **Agents ask once per project:** the first time an agent reaches another project's sessions it asks you, and then it can go on without asking again. - **Secret requests are answered only by you**, and each one is tied to the session that asked. - **Agent skills that update between releases install only when Ghostex signed them.** - **Cloud Boxes ask you before an agent puts your logins or a project's secrets on a box.**
### 💬 Chat and sessions
- **The handover headings are coloured:** Needs you pink like the sidebar's question dot, Blocked red like its red dot, and Kicked off sky blue. - **A message held because the agent's input box is off screen heals itself**, reloading the agent after a few minutes when nothing else brings the box back, and Claude Code's rating survey no longer holds a message for hours. - **An automatic reload or restart waits while the agent still has background jobs running.** - **Chief's row is drawn like a project header**, its name lined up with the projects and its flower turning into the fold chevron, on the computer and the phone. - **Clicking a Global Action in the Start menu runs it** (#501). - **A coordinator's thread on a connected computer starts in a worktree without stopping at the folder-trust question** (#502), and a stale "not moving" report is dropped instead of arriving late.
### 📲 On the phone
- **Calmer notifications:** the bell's rows read like the desktop's cards with the session's name, and a blocked session shows its red dot with the reason in its menu. - **The phone calls it the Easy Connect code** everywhere you paste or scan it.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Linux: Ghostex follows COSMIC's display scale**, Settings > Interface has a Linux-only Display scale row, and a raised Interface scale is offered a one-time reset (#503). - **Switches are clearer:** an on switch is a mid-tone track under a white handle. - **Spaces and playbook sync fixes:** each folder of a repository keeps its own playbook, a newcomer takes the shared Spaces, Settings > Sync lists projects that sync moved, and sync waits for git remotes after a start (#488). - **Alert me for says what each choice changes.** - **A session of a removed custom agent is named by its base agent**, not its raw id.

# Ghostex 11.1.0
## 11.1.0 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.1.0 is out.** A security update that puts you in charge of everything sensitive, with safer pairing for phones and computers (including over SSH and Tailscale); Collab becomes an extension you install, with a new Share popover; Chief, one agent per computer you can ask about anything; calmer notifications; a calm card when a computer is offline, with messages held until it is back; Settings in six groups; and many fixes.
### 🔐 Security update - **You approve what matters:** turning on Easy Connect, letting a computer connect, Autopilot's approvals and limits, GBots, settings that loosen security, and an agent answering, stopping or typing into another session all wait for your approval with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your system password, or Face ID or the fingerprint on your phone. - **Agents and scripts can ask but never approve:** every session gets its own key when it starts, the `ghostex` CLI waits for your approval and then repeats the call, and settings only you may change can't be written through the API. - **Settings > Security keeps a security log** of every sensitive action, chained so an edited or removed entry is flagged; `ghostex security log` shows it in a terminal, and only the important entries reach the bell and the phone. - **Easy Connect serves only SSH and Ghostex itself**, an empty allow-list lets nobody in, and file links never open keys, Ghostex's own data or a project's hidden files like `.env`. - **Every downloadable component (Collab, GBots, the browser engine) carries Ghostex's signature**, checked before it is unpacked. - **After updating, a one-time notice lists the phones and computers that connect through Easy Connect and must pair again**, with the pairing QR right there, ticking each one off as it pairs; phones and computers on Tailscale, your network or SSH keep working.
### 📲 Pairing phones and computers - **Each phone pairs with its own device key** kept in the Secure Enclave or Android Keystore: it waits as Pending with three words, and you approve it on the computer, or on a phone already paired, only when the words match. Removing a phone cuts it off at once. - **Computers pair the same way:** paste a Show QR code into Add a machine, check the three words on both screens and approve. - **Phones that sign in over Tailscale, your network or SSH pair once too**, with the same three matching words; until then answers, Stop and typing from that phone wait for your approval. Run in terminal on the phone uses the phone's own key. - **Pairing again needs the new phone app** (Android in this release, iPhone on TestFlight).
### 🤝 Ghostex Collab - **Collab is now an extension:** the Ghostex you download doesn't contain it until you install it from Settings > Extensions (or right in the Share popover), with Touch ID; Settings > Collab and Share appear once it is installed, and Uninstall ends every share. - **The new Share popover is the live panel:** the link and code, who is watching and who is waiting, a Link lasts chip with 1 hour, 4 hours, 24 hours or Until I stop it, Review for a guest's waiting message, and Stop sharing that says who gets disconnected. The phone's Share sheet matches. - **Every share, Send mode and guest message you send on asks for your approval**, links need an eight-digit code, and the guest page is pinned to the exact version your Ghostex trusts. - **Guests can answer the agent's questions and open the chat's Ghostex pages and pictures**, and the guest page works on phones; their answers wait for you like their messages. - **Collab and GBots show in Settings > Updates and the Updates menu** with Update when a new version is out.
### 🌸 Chief - **Chief is one agent per computer you can ask about anything:** any session, agent, project or computer, and Ghostex itself. # Ghostex 11.0.0
## 11.0.0 - 2026-11-07
**Ghostex 11.0.0 is out.** Share a chat with anyone through a link with Ghostex Collab, let Autopilot keep your sessions moving while you are away, build your own bots on Claude Code and Codex with GBots, dictate with Hex, sync accounts, agents and skills between your computers, and annotate pages with screenshots; the iPhone gets a Live Activity, Home Screen widgets, the iPhone Duo two-pane layout, terminal themes and a Files browser.
### 🤝 Ghostex Collab
- **Share one chat through a link:** turn it on in Settings > Collab, press Share in a chat's header and send the link and its six-digit code; the other person follows the chat live in their browser, with no app and no account, and sees who is watching and typing. - **You decide what a guest's message does,** per chat: Ask me (the default) holds it as a "Message from <name>" card with Decline, Edit and Send, Send passes it straight to the agent, and View only turns their chat box off. - **A guest only ever reaches that one chat:** they can't answer the agent's questions or permission prompts, stop it, change its model, or see any other chat, file, terminal or setting. - **Links end after 24 hours by default** (1 hour, 7 days or never in Settings > Collab), Stop sharing ends one at once, Remove keeps a guest out, and the Guest messages log lists every message and who joined or left. - **The link's traffic is locked end to end** with the key in the link, so Ghostex's share relay can't read the chat; the chat itself runs on your computer. - **The phone has the same Share sheet,** the guest message cards and Settings › Collab for each computer.
### 🛟 Autopilot
- **Autopilot keeps your sessions moving while you are away:** turn it on in Settings > Autopilot, from the Autopilot pill in a coordinator's chat, on the phone, or with `ghostex autopilot on`. - **It carries on sessions that stopped too early,** interrupts a hung command after 8 minutes, reloads a session that shows nothing, restarts a terminal that ended, and moves a session at a usage limit to the account with the most room. - **It can answer questions and approval cards for you** (both off by default): unanswered questions get their recommended choice after 5, 10 or 15 minutes, and approvals follow the Heal, Heal and decide or Everything tier you pick. - **Hard limits stay yours:** pushing, merging, releasing, deleting outside the project and posting publicly are each a switch that is off until you turn it on, and sign-ins, 2FA and payments are always declined. - **A supervisor agent wakes only for judgment calls,** in an Autopilot project in your sidebar where you can read why it did each thing, and every decision is in the Log at the bottom of Settings > Autopilot. - **Pick which sessions it covers:** every session, the projects you pick, or the sessions you pick; each chat's Autopilot pill takes that session out or puts it back.
### 🤖 GBots
- **GBots are long-lived bots on your own Claude Code or Codex** that can start, message and steer agent sessions on any of your computers. Turn them on in Settings > Extensions, under Planning and automation (off by default; macOS and Linux). - **Make a bot from the Bots space** with a name, Claude Code or Codex, and its instructions; each conversation opens in the chat like any session, on the phone too. - **Bots run on the Claude and Codex accounts in Settings > Accounts,** so a bot moves to another account when one reaches its limit, and the sessions a bot starts show in your sidebar with a card naming the bot.
### 🎙️ Dictation
- **Hex is now a Dictate engine:** pick Hex in Settings > Voice to transcribe with Hex 3, the free local dictation app (macOS on Apple silicon, Windows and Linux), and your recording never leaves the computer. Install Hex installs it for you, and the phone can pick it per computer.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Make a connected computer's session a coordinator** from the sidebar's Advanced > Make Coordinator, or with `ghostex coordinator promote --computer <name>`. - **A thread on another computer is watched like one here:** it is nudged after 8 minutes with no new output and reported finished from its transcript, so it never sits at "Working" with no report. - **DeepSeek Harness can run a coordinator,** on the desktop and the phone (#480). - **A thread's and a coordinator's agent start with `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_ROLE`** in their environment, so a launch wrapper can tell them apart, for example to start threads with fewer MCP servers (#463). - **The board's Moving group is now called In progress.**
### 🔄 Sync
- **Accounts, Agents and Skills can sync between your paired computers** (Settings > Sync, each off by default): the Claude and Codex account list without the logins, which agents are on with their commands and order, and your own skills in `~/.agents/skills`.
### 🖍️ Browser and Files
- **Annotate captures a picture of each spot you pick,** and Send puts your notes and their pictures into the agent session you last clicked: its chat box, its terminal, or the clipboard. HTML files in the Files view get the same. - **A file link in a remote chat opens in Files** for any file in the project, and a text file outside it (an agent's log, say) opens read-only (#462). - **The Files page's fonts load again,** and a drawing opened during a project switch no longer shows "Files request timed out."
